title: THE FAIRNESS FIELD GUIDE: PERSPECTIVES FROM SOCIAL AND FORMAL SCIENCES
findings: The paper identifies religion as a 'Marginalization (Sensitive/Protected) Characteristic' that should be considered in fair machine learning frameworks. However, it does not conduct any specific analysis or provide findings related to religion beyond this categorization.
